summary_bullets.claim: Ease of use is a dominant strength — emphasize this in marketing copy.

evidence.quote: Very easy 2 use, easy 2 find a specific verse. Of all the bible apps on Amazon's Appstore this is the one I would recommend

summary_bullets.claim: Customizability is a key feature — highlight in marketing materials.

summary_bullets.claim: Offline access is a major selling point — emphasize in marketing copy.
